behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: remaining earliest opener and ignored text
docDelivery: Explain pure inspection, ignored text, first closing mismatch vs earliest remaining opener and UTF16 offsets.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Extract inspect(text) to src/brackets.mjs and delegate check(text) in src/check.mjs to it. Preserve bracket stack rules for () [] {}, ignoring all other characters (quotes have no special meaning). First mismatching/unmatched closing bracket reports {ok:false,index:UTF16 offset}; if end reached with openers report earliest remaining opener index, otherwise {ok:true,index:null}. check returns "ok" or "unbalanced at INDEX". Domain arbitrary UTF16 text<=10000 units. No I/O, regex-only balancing or duplicated algorithm in consumer.
manualBehavior: check delegates to inspect; no duplicated balancing loop
independence: Explicit synthetic library contract; alternatives judged by observable exports and required integration, not reference-source matching.
